01 / An exercise in engineered desire   ·   Creative Director Pt. 1
01 / Campaign positioning

The proposition.

EST. IN AN IMAGINED TOMORROW

A delicacy so exclusive, nature never intended for you to taste it.

Nature made it rare.
We made it yours.

PINK ORCA™ is a speculative, satirical New York City launch campaign imagining Impossible Foods introducing an ultra-premium, laboratory-cultivated orca-meat delicacy.

The campaign borrows the unquestioning confidence of luxury advertising, exclusive fine dining, and proprietary biotechnology. A biologically improbable, morally provocative product is presented not as a controversy, but as the ultimate consumer privilege.

Our premise: what happens when technological hubris is no longer hidden behind reassuring corporate language—and is instead sold as the most desirable thing money can buy?

Creative register: aristocratic entitlement, clinical seduction, sculptural food imagery, Black Mirror-esque corporate dystopia, and absolute deadpan seriousness.

Audience and setting: status-driven New York tastemakers, imagined members-only tasting rooms, luxury retail, subway installations and Manhattan billboards.

Twenty studies

1920 × 1080 / 20 IMAGES

A visual narrative moving through five worlds: product seduction, biotech control, branded ocean mythology, elite consumption and public-space takeover. All imagery is AI-generated under a unified creative direction.

03 / Chromatic system

Artificially
exquisite.

EIGHT CONTROLLED COLORS

Obsidian controls the scene; chrome certifies the science; soft pink conveys status. One lurid specimen fuchsia makes the engineered product impossible to mistake for ordinary meat. Deep Blood is reserved for a deliberately provocative final detail.

05 / AI-generated mark

The proprietary
fin.

INITIAL LOGOMARK EXPLORATION

Our preliminary logomark combines an orca dorsal fin with the marbling of a premium cultivated meat cut, rendered as an austere corporate seal.

The fin is not a mascot: it is an insignia of proprietary ownership, intended for black embossed cartons, titanium instrument plates, specimen certificates and monumental campaign signage.

This image is a preliminary AI-generated exploration; final vector refinement belongs to the later campaign rollout.

06 / Execution principles

Never apologize.

Desire.

Lurid pink meat is irresistibly glossy, physically plausible in texture yet impossible in color, housed like a priceless artifact.

Power.

Black glass, titanium, expensive silence and monumental laboratories present control over nature as a private entitlement.

Vice.

The audience is unflinching; dark-burgundy traces are luxury ornaments, never guilt or apology. The brand never winks at the joke.
